execution_path: interactive native Codex TUI under Orca-managed terminal
runtime_profile: harness-eval applied to tool children only; TUI parent is a host process, not a VM

criteria.check: Cancellation propagates as CancelledError after the still-running direct child is terminated and reaped.
Timeout remains the existing OrcaError after the still-running direct child is terminated and reaped.
Cancellation is not swallowed or converted into timeout, and timeout is not converted into cancellation.
Nonzero and non-JSON outcomes remain visible; shell-like input remains a literal argv value and does not execute.
Compatibility tests independently force cancellation and timeout and assert child cleanup plus error and argv behavior.
A fresh wheel builds/installs offline, the full project suite passes, and the product diff is limited to orca.py and test_harness_compatibility.py.

baseline_reference: T14 pilot frozen baseline calibration is reused only if a fresh F01 baseline run confirms the same grader signature.
network: offline pip and local fake CLI only

cancellation_cleanup.detail: cancellation propagates after direct child exits and is reaped

literal_argv.detail: shell-like text remains one literal argv value and creates no marker

non_json_error.detail: invalid JSON is surfaced as OrcaError

nonzero_error.detail: nonzero exit is surfaced as OrcaError

timeout_cleanup.detail: timeout is surfaced and direct child has exited and been reaped

baseline_calibration.note: Fresh pinned-snapshot calibration: offline build/install and all 58 existing tests pass. The frozen grader independently confirms nonzero/non-JSON visibility, timeout cleanup, and literal argv; it fails only cancellation cleanup.
